I've reviewed customer telemetry for Acme (Q3→rolling 7d). Key notes for the watchboard:

1) Latency: P95 increased from 420ms → 650ms on Sept 15 coincident with a model variant rollout. Root cause: mis-sized batching profile for mobile tail. Mitigation: rollback + controlled canary (owner: Lauren, target complete Oct 9).

2) Error rate: transient spike tied to a 3rd-party tokenization library update on Sept 18. We've scoped a hotfix and are testing on staging (owner: infra team).

3) Business impact: Acme’s mobile app sends ~1.2B tokens/month through Redwood for feature X; estimated penalty band (if SLA hit) puts near-term at-risk ARR at ~$620k. We should present a price-protection offer and a 30-day technical remediation SLA.

I updated the attached sheet with severity flags and recommended exec asks (see bottom sheet). Please review before our prep call.
